history.summary: Large 1475 sqft 99yr 4BR at Costa Del Sol (D16) at $3.0M / $2034 PSF, 240m from the new Bayshore MRT (TE29). Standout 6.68% URA resale CAGR over a deep 168-txn series, with the just-opened Bayshore station finally fixing this seafront estate's long-standing accessibility gap.
history.rating_rationale: The low 415 score_1000 is misleading — it penalizes the $3M quantum and 99yr lease, but the fundamentals are strong: 6.68% resale CAGR backed by 168 transactions (very high confidence), 240m to the new Bayshore MRT (a genuine re-rating catalyst), seafront living, and entry only ~2% above the $1999 median. The real risk is supply — two adjacent 1,000+ unit estates (Bayshore Park, The Bayshore) compete for tenants/buyers — and $3M thins the pool. On balance the transit catalyst plus proven appreciation outweigh these.
red_flags: $3.0M quantum sits above the deepest buyer band — slower exit
Heavy nearby supply (Bayshore Park, The Bayshore, new Bayshore precinct launches) competes for tenants/buyers
2004 99yr lease (~78yr left) — lease decay on the back end
catalysts: Bayshore MRT (TE29) 240m away — direct TEL access, resolves the estate's accessibility weakness
6.68% URA resale CAGR over 168 txns — among the strongest, best-evidenced in the batch
Seafront/East Coast lifestyle premium and Bayshore precinct rejuvenation
